f.title: Report drug ADRs, research reports and clinical trial reports electronically to PMDA in principle
f.statement: For post-marketing drug ADR reports and drug/quasi-drug/cosmetic research reports or clinical trial ADR reports, reporting is in principle by electronic data processing system (method 1). Where electronic reporting is difficult for unavoidable reasons, CD etc. (method 2) or paper (method 3) may be used, but companies are asked to move to electronic reporting as far as possible.

rows.quote_en: Each report category shall be as follows (references are to the Regulations). AA = Domestic infection case report (PM) (Art. 228-20(1)(i)(f),(g)); AB = Domestic ADR case report (PM) (Art. 228-20(1)(i)(a)-(e) and (ii)(a)); AC = Foreign infection case report (PM) (Art. 228-20(1)(i)(g)); AD = Foreign ADR case report (PM) (Art. 228-20(1)(i)(b),(c)); AE = Infection research report (PM) (Art. 228-20(1)(ii)(b)); AF = ADR research report (PM) (Art. 228-20(1)(ii)(b)); AG = Report of measures abroad such as discontinuation of manufacture, recall, disposal (PM) (Art. 228-20(1)(i)(h)); BA = Quasi-drug ADR report (PM) (Art. 228-20(5)(i) and (ii)(a)); BB = Cosmetic ADR report (PM) (Art. 228-20, item 5(i) and (ii)(a)); BC = Quasi-drug research report (PM) (Art. 228-20(5)(ii)(b)); BD = Cosmetic research report (PM) (Art. 228-20(5)(ii)(b)); DA = Domestic infection case report (CT) (Art. 273(1)(i),(ii)); DB = Domestic ADR case report (CT) (Art. 273(1)(i),(ii)); DC = Foreign infection case report (CT) (Art. 273(1)(i),(ii), (2)(i) and (2)(ii)(a),(b)); DD = Foreign ADR case report (CT) (Art. 273(1)(i),(ii), (2)(i) and (2)(ii)(a),(b)); DE = Infection research report (CT) (Art. 273(2)(ii)(d)); DF = ADR research report (CT) (Art. 273(2)(ii)(d)); DG = Report of measures abroad such as discontinuation of manufacture, recall, disposal (CT) (Art. 273(2)(ii)(c)); Withdrawal = the "withdrawal report" in each report. [PM = post-marketing; CT = clinical trial; ADR = adverse reaction.]

rows.quote: 被験薬については最新の治験薬概要書に記載されている有害事象から判断する。ただし、治験の依頼をしようとする者が、複数の被験薬を用いる治験を実施する場合で、自らが製造販売する予定の被験薬と併用するものの、他社が製造販売している等の理由で、治験薬概要書を準備出来ない場合は、本邦で既承認の有効成分であり、治験の依頼をしようとする者が当該被験薬を治験に用いるにあたり被験者の安全性を担保出来ると考える場合に限り、当該被験薬の治験薬概要書に代わり、当該被験薬の最新の科学的知見を記載した文書（添付文書、インタビューフォーム又は学術論文等）に基づき判断することで差し支えない。また、被験薬以外の治験使用薬については最新の科学的知見を記載した文書に基づき判断する。

For investigational products other than the test drug, judge on the basis of the document describing the latest scientific knowledge.

rows.quote_en: Prepare a document stating the following and submit it to the Review Planning Division, Office of Review Management of the Agency. 1) The title shall be "Request for suspension of investigational drug adverse reaction/infection case reports". 2) State the clinical trial ingredient code, with the generic name in parentheses. 3) State the number of clinical trial plan notifications and the date of the first clinical trial plan notification. 4) State the planned indications or effects. 5) State the development phase of the trial to be interrupted. 6) State specifically the "reason for suspending reporting". 7) State, among other things, that "information on adverse reactions etc. will continue to be collected", that "when development is resumed, adverse reactions etc. collected during the period of interruption will be reported" and that "when development is resumed, the Review Planning Division, Office of Review Management of the Agency will be contacted in advance". 8) State the name and contact details of the person in charge. 9) The addressee shall be "Chief Executive, Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency".

f.statement: When development resumes, lift the suspension and resume ADR reporting, submitting to PMDA's Review Planning Division a "治験薬副作用・感染症症例報告留保解除申出書" (reason, period and reason for lifting), the periodic report forms 1 and 2 and the DSUR, and the revised or corresponding parts of the IB/protocol and application summary prepared from information collected during the suspension.
f.clause: 別添 8.(3)ウ(ウ) Documents on resumption
f.applicability: Current base notice (MHLW two-division-director notice 薬生薬審発0831第12号・薬生安発0831第3号, 31 Aug 2020, applies from 1 Sep 2020); its attachments 別紙1/別紙2 were later revised (24 Jun 2022; 15 Jan 2024) - check the amendments. Original language Japanese. Post-marketing ADR/infection reports (PMD Act Art 68-10(1)) and clinical trial ADR reports (Art 80-2(6)) to PMDA in E2B(R3) format.

rows.actor: Clinical trial sponsor
rows.quote: 開発を再開する場合には、留保を解除し、副作用等報告を再開すること。その際には以下の内容を記載した文書を作成し、機構審査マネジメント部審査企画課に提出すること。① 標題は「治験薬副作用・感染症症例報告留保解除申出書」とし、留保した理由、留保期間及び留保を解除する理由を記載すること。② 「治験副作用等症例の定期報告に係る留意事項について」 （令和２年８月 31 日付け薬生薬審発 0831 第 14 号厚生労働省医薬・生活衛生局医薬品審査管理課長通知）の別紙様式１、別紙様式２及び治験安全性最新報告（DSUR）を提出すること。③ 留保期間中に収集した情報に基づいて作成された治験薬概要書等又は治験実施計画書及び申請資料概要の改訂部分又は対応部分

Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When development is resumed, lift the suspension and resume adverse reaction reporting. In that case, prepare a document stating the following and submit it to the Review Planning Division, Office of Review Management of the Agency. (1) The title shall be "Request for lifting of suspension of investigational drug adverse reaction/infection case reports", and state the reason for suspension, the period of suspension and the reason for lifting the suspension. (2) Submit Forms 1 and 2 annexed to "Points to note on periodic reports of clinical trial adverse reaction cases" (PSEHB/PED Notification No. 0831-14 dated 31 August 2020 of the Director of the Pharmaceutical Evaluation Division, Pharmaceutical Safety and Environmental Health Bureau, Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare) and the Development Safety Update Report (DSUR). (3) The revised or corresponding parts of the Investigator's Brochure etc. or the protocol and the summary of the application dossier prepared on the basis of information collected during the suspension period

f.title: Approval holder may file foreign cases for a third-party partial-change trial if a written agreement is filed
f.statement: Where a party other than the approval holder is the in-country caretaker for a partial-change trial of an approved drug and the two share information appropriately, the approval holder may file the foreign ADR case reports, provided a document agreeing reporting and information sharing for foreign cases is prepared in advance and submitted to PMDA's Review Planning Division.
